response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile senior engineer, but their profile is a poor match for this specific role. Their C++ experience is limited to a ~7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015 and a university thesis project, far short of the mandatory 5–10 years of hands-on Windows C++ development. They also lack any Fixed Income, Capital Markets, or Investment Banking domain experience (RIDE Capital was a startup investment platform, not capital markets), and show no SQL Server/Oracle depth. Most recent work centers on TypeScript/Node.js and DLang.
strengths: Extensive overall software engineering experience (15+ years) with strong engineering practices (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development)
Low-latency, high-throughput systems experience (millions of requests/sec at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic)
Strong communication skills evidenced by workshops, conference talks, and teaching
concerns: Only ~7 months of professional C++ experience, and none recent or on Windows-focused enterprise systems
No Fixed Income, Capital Markets, or Investment Banking domain expertise
No demonstrated SQL Server or Oracle experience; database background is MongoDB/MySQL

key_factors.factor: Missing capital markets / fixed income domain knowledge
Strong general engineering and performance-systems background
